_comment: Hoodrich dealers -- the people you buy BULK from. Bulk cannot be sold until it has been
bagged up at the kitchen counter in the stash house.
Only the dock worker lives here. Buying off a gang is done by walking up to their leader
and asking him, so there is no second layer of corner dealers standing around doing the
same job. Independent suppliers for the other products come back later.
THE PROGRESSION: Stretch is where you start. Once you have moved enough weight
(Economy > DocksUnlockGrams in Hoodrich.ini, default 50g) he names the port, which is
what makes the dock worker -- and with him the whole catalogue at the best price -- exist
for you. Call him from the wheel and he drives out to you.
drugs            what they sell. EMPTY means the whole catalogue -- that is the docks.
zones            GET_NAME_OF_ZONE codes they stand in
models           ped models tried IN ORDER; first one present in your install wins
priceMultiplier  applied to the wholesale price. Below 1.0 is a better deal.
openHour/closeHour  operating hours, 0-24. Wraps midnight when open > close.
greeting / buyLine / sourceReply / sourceTooSoon / farewell  what they say to you

dealers.name: Tao Cheng
dealers.greeting: Stretch's people. Stretch's. Yeah. Keep it quiet, keep it quick, and whatever's in the box -- I get it off the box. That's the. that's the whole business, right there.
dealers.buyLine: Bricks. I deal in bricks, nothing smaller, dont ask. So say what, and say how many. In that order please.
dealers.sourceReply: Where do I get it. Where do I -- man. I AM where you get it. I'm the. yeah. me.
dealers.farewell: Go on. Go. And dont come back in daylight if youre carryin, thats. thats just manners.
dealers.openingText: my friend. my FRIEND. whatever you need i have it. bricks only tho. dont ask me for grams, thats. thats insulting
dealers.textCalled: yeah yeah im comin. give me a. give me a minute
dealers.textLeaving: leaving now. dont go anywhere. im leaving NOW
dealers.textOutside: im outside. im outside your. im here. come out

dealers.name: Stretch
dealers.greeting: You called, I pedalled. All the way from the block on a BIKE, homie, so don't waste my time. What you need?
dealers.buyLine: I ain't the port. Don't ask me for no bricks. Weed, pills, bars -- that's what I move. Say what and say how much.
dealers.sourceReply: The port? Man, I'll put you on when you moved enough for it to be worth my name. Not before.
dealers.sourceTooSoon: Nah. Keep sellin' and ask me again.
dealers.farewell: Aight. And next time somebody's ridin' out here, it better be you.
dealers.openingText: heard you workin now. aight. weed, pills, bars, thats me. and dont be callin me for no bricks, im not the port
dealers.textCalled: aight. im comin. and you gon remember i came out for you
dealers.textLeaving: on the bike now. dont have me sat out there waitin. thats how people get caught slippin
dealers.textOutside: im outside. come get it. i aint standin on no corner for nobody
